name: Templated
description_en:
Templated renders images, videos and PDFs from reusable templates whose text, colors and image layers are supplied through data. It combines a visual editor with REST, no-code integrations and agent connections.

This is primarily template automation: the task is to bind correct data into a controlled layout. AI-assisted template creation does not remove the need to validate names, prices, page breaks and image permissions before batch output.
description_zh:
Templated 按可复用模板渲染图片、视频及 PDF，数据替换文字、颜色和图片层，结合可视编辑器、REST、无代码及 Agent 连接。

核心是模板自动化，将正确数据放入受控版式；AI 建模板不能省略姓名、价格、分页及图片许可核查。

core_features.explanation_en: Update named layers and render image/video/PDF outputs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 更新命名图层并渲染图片/视频/PDF。

core_features.name_zh: 自动化及 Agent 访问
core_features.explanation_en: Use REST, listed workflow integrations or an authorized MCP connection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用 REST、所列工作流集成或获授权 MCP 连接。

en: Render checked certificates from structured names using an approved template.
zh: 从结构姓名数据按已审模板生成证书。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Approve edge-case data in one template, render a small batch and inspect files, credits and completion handling.
steps.zh: 先用边界数据审模板，小批渲染并核文件、额度及完成处理。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Monthly rendering credits with annual billing display and format-dependent consumption.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual equivalents Starter $29/month/1,000 credits, Scale $79/5,000, Enterprise $179/25,000. Image one credit, PDF one/page, video resolution×FPS×duration formula; fifty-credit trial. Rate/template/member limits apply.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年付折月 Starter $29/1,000、Scale $79/5,000、Enterprise $179/25,000。图一额、PDF每页一额、视频按尺寸×帧率×时长，试50额；速率/模板/成员有限。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Approve the hardest row before generating a batch
sections.en: For illustrative certificates, start with the longest name, special characters and a missing field. Confirm font support, overflow, alignment and PDF page count before processing the rest. Keep template IDs and data mappings stable; an attractive template cannot correct a wrong recipient or amount. The documented API modifies layers rather than verifying business facts.
sections.zh: 例如证书，先用最长姓名、特殊字符及缺字段，核字体、溢出、对齐及 PDF 页数，再批量。稳定模板 ID/数据映射，好看模板不能改正收件人或金额错误，API 改图层而不核业务事实。

sections.title_en: Count image, PDF page and video consumption separately
sections.title_zh: 分别计图片、PDF 页及视频
sections.en: Annual-billed displays are Starter $29/month for 1,000 credits, Scale $79 for 5,000 and Enterprise $179 for 25,000. Images cost one credit, PDFs one per page; video uses width×height×FPS×seconds divided by 50,000,000. The examples imply rounding to whole credits but exact rounding/minimum is unverified. Fifty free credits are a trial, not an established recurring allowance.
sections.zh: 年付折月 Starter $29/1,000 额、Scale $79/5,000、Enterprise $179/25,000。图一额、PDF 每页一额，视频宽×高×FPS×秒÷50,000,000；示例似整额取整，但精确/最低未核。免费 50 为试用，不证明周期赠额。

sections.title_en: Plan for rate limits and delivery permissions
sections.en: The comparison lists 60/150/300 requests per minute, 15/100/unlimited templates and 2/5/20 members. Scale adds an embedded editor and own S3/R2 delivery. OAuth agent access uses the same credits as API rendering, so agent output is not cost-free. Inspect job completion, destination access and duplicate-trigger behavior; do not assume a timed-out client means no render occurred.
sections.zh: 表列每分 60/150/300 请求、模板15/100/不限、成员2/5/20。Scale 增嵌入编辑器及自有 S3/R2，OAuth Agent 与 API 同耗额，不是免费。需核任务完成、目标访问及重复触发，客户端超时不证明没渲染。

sections.title_zh: 试点数据到文件全路径
sections.en: Templated merits evaluation for repeat certificates, catalog pages or campaign layouts driven by structured data. Test a small batch, validate every file and retain the source mapping. No API, OAuth, MCP, webhook, editor embed or storage write was executed; latency, SLA and customer-scale claims were not independently measured. Refund, retention and source license remain unknown.
sections.zh: 结构数据驱动的重复证书、目录或营销版式可评估 Templated。应小批量逐文件核并保留映射。本文未调用 API/OAuth/MCP/Webhook、嵌入或写存储，延迟、SLA 及规模未独立测，退款/保留/源码许可未知。

research_gaps: No API, editor, integration, OAuth/MCP, webhook, storage or render quality tested.
Credit rounding, rollover, failure/retry charging, refund, retention, source license and self-hosting unverified.
